changes.summary: 'We are good friends and share the same path in art' – Letter from Li Jin to Roger Law, 2003 This exhibition showcased work by the contemporary Chinese ink master Li Jin – his first solo show in the UK – alongside a selection of drawings and ceramic work by the British caricaturist Roger Law and some of their correspondence. The two artists have been friends for many years. Both share a sense of humour and sharp observation in their artistic endeavours and appreciation of each other's art. Active since the 1980s, Li Jin is best known for his playful and witty depictions of the sensory pleasure of the ordinaries, which subvert the classical themes of an ideal, elegant, and serene life in Chinese literati painting. Li Jin often accompanies his artworks with calligraphy of Buddhist texts.
